title: avena strigosa var. glaberrima
intro: Avena strigosa var. glaberrima, commonly known as oat grass, is a type of oat grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Avena strigosa var. glaberrima include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety properties, which can help to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include avenanthramides, avenacosides, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
